build_deformable_detr_image_processor: build a DeformableDetrImageProcessor to preprocess images and annotations for object detection with configurable resize, pad, normalize, and annotation conversion
run_preprocess_images_annotations: run the preprocess method to resize, pad, normalize images and convert COCO annotations into DEFORMABLE_DETR target format with pixel masks
run_post_process_object_detection: run post_process_object_detection to convert raw model logits and bounding boxes into filtered detection results with scores, labels, and boxes
test_prepare_coco_detection_annotation: test prepare_coco_detection_annotation to convert COCO detection annotations into center_x, center_y, width, height format normalized to [0, 1]
test_masks_to_boxes: test masks_to_boxes to compute bounding boxes from panoptic segmentation masks in xyxy format
